This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Announcement" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their thick, fleshy features, with [[Color|pink]] skin, and spiky ridges on the tops of their heads as well as on their forearms.<ref name="Announcement" /> They also possessed large feet, and elongated tails.<ref name="Make It Stop" />


==Species in the galaxy==
[[File:Unidentified-Species-Niamos-Tail.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A member of this species in the Lina Soh Hospital]]
In [[5 BBY]], a [[cyborg]] member of this species was enjoying the [[Niamos Beach|beaches]] of the [[planet]] [[Niamos]], playing a game of physical [[Dejarik]] with another [[human]] when [[Cassian Jeron Andor]] was wrongly arrested by the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Announcement" /> By [[1 BBY]], another member of this species was a patient at the [[Lina Soh Hospital]] on the planet [[Coruscant]] when [[Kleya Marki]] arrived in search of [[Luthen Rael]].<ref name="Make It Stop" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified-Species-Niamos-BTS.png|thumb|right|200px|Creation of this species behind-the-scenes]]
This species first appeared in the [[Announcement|seventh episode]] of the television series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']], directed by [[Benjamin Caron]].<ref name="Announcement" />
